# Thing

## Requirements

### Requirement: Thing Is Checked

An *analysis tool* [ANALYSISTOOL] reads the files. By *Occam's razor* [OCCAMSRAZOR], the shorter instruction wins. A record names its *change* [CHANGE-KEY]. A second *analysis tool* [ANALYSISTOOL] citation becomes a plain link. A code span such as `*analysis tool* [ANALYSISTOOL]` is not read. The *ghost* [GHOST] names a term the ontology never had. The *[ghost thing][GHOSTTHING]* link already has the new form, and its page does not exist yet.

#### Scenario: Tool reads a file

- **WHEN** the analysis tool reads a file
- **THEN** it reports each finding

[ANALYSISTOOL]: https://runedeck.ai/ns#AnalysisTool
[OCCAMSRAZOR]: https://runedeck.ai/ns#OccamsRazor
[CHANGE-KEY]: https://runedeck.ai/ns#change
[GHOST]: https://runedeck.ai/ns#Ghost
